source_name: EUDI Wallet Architecture and Reference Framework
requirement: Implement state transitions for PIDs and attestations to handle expiration and revocation, ensuring they cannot transition back to Valid once expired or revoked.
evidence_quote: There are two possible transitions for a valid PID or attestation: it expires by passing through the validity end date and transitions to the Expired state, or it is revoked by its PID Provider or Attestation Provider, ending up in the Revoked state. Expiration and revocation are independent transitions. Once a PID or attestation is expired or revoked, it cannot transition back to Valid.
